description: Get the live operational status of every major AI service tracked by TensorFeed (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Cohere, Mistral, HuggingFace, Replicate, Midjourney, etc). Polled every 2 min. Returns operational | degraded | down | unknown per service, with the time each was last checked. Per-component detail is on /api/status.
name: get_status_summary
